ground_truth_scope: Mocoa urban area affected by debris flow / flash flood overnight 31 Mar–1 Apr 2017. Not a pixel flood-extent map.

citations.title: UNGRD repository record of the Mocoa night

limitations: All three units share the same documented urban inundation (no independent non-event control); FAR is therefore not computed.
Binary GT is municipal/urban occurrence from official reports, not a surveyed flood outline.
The event was a debris flow / flash flood; V1 PHI is a pluvial rainfall-threshold ranking, not a debris-flow model.
106 mm is a 3-hour cited total and 129.3 mm is a 24-hour cited total, scored with 1-hour T0/T1.
ERA5 1.3 mm at 01:00 COT is a legally fetched public reanalysis hour; it does not reproduce the convective burst.
Exposure and vulnerability remain PLACEHOLDER stubs.
T0=10 mm and T1=80 mm are demo constants, not a calibrated IDF.
